runuser -u nodeapp -- env HOME=/home/nodeapp XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$uid podman info --format 'rootless={{.Host.Security.Rootless}}'
runuser -u nodeapp -- env HOME=/home/nodeapp XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$uid podman ps --filter name=node-hello --format 'container={{.Names}} status={{.Status}} ports={{.Ports}} image={{.Image}}'
resp=/tmp/node-hello-post-reboot
code=$(curl --retry 10 --retry-delay 1 --retry-connrefused --silent --show-error --output "$resp" --write-out '%{http_code}' "http://$NODE_IP:8080/")
printf 'http_code=%s\n' "$code"
printf 'body='; cat "$resp"; printf '\n'
printf 'body_bytes='; wc -c < "$resp"
printf 'body_hex='; od -An -tx1 "$resp" | tr -d ' \n'; printf '\n'
test "$code" = 200
test "$(cat "$resp")" = 'Hello, world!'
test "$(wc -c < "$resp" | tr -d ' ')" = 13
ss -ltn '( sport = :8080 )'
rm -f "$resp"
stdout:
boot_id=00eb73eb-10e5-41e0-8dd3-620baa52af89
linger=yes
service_enabled=enabled
service_active=active
rootless=true
container=node-hello status=Up 8 seconds ports=0.0.0.0:8080->8080/tcp image=localhost/node-hello:latest
http_code=200
body=Hello, world!
body_bytes=13
body_hex=48656c6c6f2c20776f726c6421
State  Recv-Q Send-Q Local Address:Port Peer Address:Port
LISTEN 0      128          0.0.0.0:8080      0.0.0.0:*
